# Malpani M SoulStrings - Comprehensive Technical & Real Estate Master Knowledge Document

## 1. Project Overview & Developer Pedigree
Malpani M SoulStrings is the flagship ultra-luxury residential development by Malpani Estates, located on the prestigious Baner-Pashan Link Road in Pune West, Maharashtra. Malpani Estates is the real estate division of the esteemed Malpani Group, a diversified conglomerate with a 30+ year track record spanning education, green energy, FMCG, hospitality, and landmark real estate developments across Western India.

- **Developer**: Malpani Estates
- **MahaRERA Registration**: P52100076782 (Wing B) | P52100055678 (Wing C)
- **Official Website**: https://www.malpanimsoulstrings.com
- **Google Maps Knowledge Graph**: `/g/11l2r1p7gl` (18.5449193, 73.7910949)
- **Master Plan**: 5.20 Acres of low-density landscaped grounds with 4 high-rise towers and only 455 exclusive residences.

## 2. Spatial Dimension & Configuration Matrix

### 3 BHK Premium Luxury Flats
- **Carpet Area**: 1,450 to 1,650 Sq.Ft. (134.7 - 153.3 Sq.M.)
- **Price**: ₹1.95 Cr - ₹2.40 Cr
- **Layout Highlights**:
  - Living & Formal Dining: 22'0" × 14'6" (319 sq.ft.)
  - Private Double-Height Sundeck: 14'6" × 6'0" (87 sq.ft.)
  - Master Bedroom Suite: 16'0" × 12'6" (200 sq.ft.)
  - Junior Suite (Bedroom 2): 14'0" × 11'6" (161 sq.ft.)
  - Bedroom 3 (Kids / Study): 12'6" × 11'0" (138 sq.ft.)
  - Bespoke Modular Kitchen: 12'0" × 9'0" (108 sq.ft.)
  - Utility & Dry Balcony: 7'6" × 5'0" (38 sq.ft.)

### 4 BHK Ultra-Luxury Presidential Estates
- **Carpet Area**: 1,950 to 2,600 Sq.Ft. (181.2 - 241.5 Sq.M.)
- **Price**: ₹3.50 Cr - ₹4.20 Cr
- **Layout Highlights**:
  - Grand Living & Dining Great Room: 26'6" × 16'0" (424 sq.ft.)
  - Private Scenic Sundeck: 16'0" × 7'6" (120 sq.ft.)
  - Presidential Master Suite: 18'0" × 14'0" (252 sq.ft.)
  - Master Dressing & Luxury 5-Fixture Bath: 12'0" × 8'6" (102 sq.ft.)
  - Junior Suites (Bedrooms 2 & 3): 15'0" × 13'0" & 14'6" × 12'0"
  - Bedroom 4 / Home Office: 13'0" × 11'6" (150 sq.ft.)
  - Gourmet Kitchen & Breakfast Bar: 14'0" × 10'6" (147 sq.ft.)
  - Domestic Staff Quarters & Service Entry: 8'0" × 6'0" (48 sq.ft.)

### 5 BHK Sky Duplexes & Penthouses
- **Carpet Area**: 3,400 to 4,500+ Sq.Ft. (315.9 - 418.1+ Sq.M.)
- **Price**: ₹5.50 Cr - ₹6.50 Cr+
- **Layout Highlights**:
  - Double-Height Living Room with 20ft Ceilings: 30'0" × 20'0" (600 sq.ft.)
  - Rooftop Sky Deck / Open-Air Viewing Terrace: 28'0" × 18'0" (504 sq.ft.)
  - Independent Master Suites on both upper and lower levels for multi-generational living.
  - Private pneumatic glass elevator & floating staircase options.
  - Acoustically isolated private cinema / cigar lounge.

---

## 3. Engineering, Architecture & Vastu Principles

1. **Mivan Monolithic Aluminum Formwork**:
   - Monolithic cast-in-place concrete structure providing high seismic resistance (Zone III/IV compliance) and 100% leak-proof joinery.
2. **Acoustic & Thermal Isolation**:
   - Double-Glazed Units (DGU) with argon gas gap providing 32dB acoustic dampening and 40% thermal heat deflection.
3. **100% Classical Vastu Shastra Compliance**:
   - Auspicious East-West entry axes.
   - Agneya (South-East) kitchen placement honoring the fire element.
   - Nairutya (South-West) master suites for stability, leadership, and restorative sleep.
   - Open Brahmasthan central living core maximizing cross-ventilation.

---

## 4. Location & Micro-Market Advantage

- **Balewadi High Street**: 8 Minutes (2.4 km) - Cosmopolitan dining, craft breweries, and luxury retail.
- **Hinjewadi IT Park Phase 1**: 12 Minutes (8.2 km) - Via direct bypass route.
- **Mumbai-Pune Expressway**: 10 Minutes (1.1 km) - Swift highway gateway.
- **Jupiter Hospital & Manipal Hospital**: 8 Minutes (3.2 km) - Multi-specialty healthcare.
- **The Orchid School & VIBGYOR High**: 5 to 10 Minutes.
- **Micro-Climate**: Situated against the Sus Hills forest ridge; temperatures are consistently 2°C cooler with clean AQI air year-round.
